recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式細胞雙參數圖：紅色族群集中在左上象限（Q1），即 TCRγδ 陽性、TCRαβ 陰性，形成一團緊密的單一族群，綠色的背景正常 T 細胞則為 TCRαβ 陽性；γδ T 細胞異常擴增支持 γδ 型 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: TCR gamma/delta PE (y-axis) vs TCR alpha/beta FITC (x-axis)
Dominant, tight red population in Q1: TCR gamma/delta positive, TCR alpha/beta negative
Green background T cells in Q3/Q4: TCR gamma/delta negative with dim to moderate TCR alpha/beta
Small light-blue population near the origin, negative for both TCRs (likely B and NK cells)
Clustered, homogeneous expression pattern of the gamma/delta population suggests clonal expansion
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays TCR gamma/delta (y-axis) versus TCR alpha/beta (x-axis). The predominant population (red) is TCR gamma/delta-positive and TCR alpha/beta-negative, forming a compact, homogeneous cluster in the upper left quadrant, while a smaller residual population of background T cells (green) expresses TCR alpha/beta without TCR gamma/delta. A minor double-negative population (blue) likely represents non-T lymphocytes. An expanded, phenotypically uniform gamma/delta T-cell population in the appropriate clinical and morphologic setting is consistent with gamma/delta T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia; clonality should be confirmed by TCR gene rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive expansions (e.g., infection, post-transplant) are polyclonal on TCR gene rearrangement or V-delta/V-gamma repertoire analysis and are usually transient, whereas T-LGL leukemia is clonal and persistent.

Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma is also usually gamma/delta but presents with hepatosplenomegaly, sinusoidal marrow infiltration, CD56 positivity, isochromosome 7q and aggressive course rather than indolent cytopenias with LGL morphology.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous or mucosal gamma/delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are aggressive extranodal tumors with tissue masses and cytotoxic phenotype, not a circulating indolent LGL population.
The more common alpha/beta type would place the clonal CD8+ population in the TCR alpha/beta-positive quadrant, not the TCR gamma/delta quadrant.
